command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$devs=@('AGG_SW_01','Core_SW_01','Core_SW_02','BJHQ_CSR1000V_GW_01','PE1','PE2','PE3','SZ_AR','SZ_Core'); `$cmds=@('display current-configuration','show running-config'); foreach (`$dev in `$devs) { `$out5=`$null; `$out6=`$null; foreach (`$cmd in `$cmds) { `$u5='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_05/nodes/'+[uri]::EscapeDataString(`$dev)+'/command?cmd='+[uri]::EscapeDataString(`$cmd); `$u6='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_06/nodes/'+[uri]::EscapeDataString(`$dev)+'/command?cmd='+[uri]::EscapeDataString(`$cmd); `$r5=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u5 -Method Get; `$r6=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u6 -Method Get; if (`$r5.output -notlike 'Error: Command*' -and `$r6.output -notlike 'Error: Command*') { `$out5=`$r5.output; `$out6=`$r6.output; break } }; if (`$out5) { `$a=`$out5 -split '\r?\n' | ForEach-Object { `$_.Trim() } | Where-Object { `$_ -and `$_ -notmatch '^!Time:|^!Last configuration|^Last configuration|^snmp-server user|^username admin password|^crypto pki|^subject-name|^rsakeypair|^quit|^[0-9A-F ]{20,}$' } | Sort-Object -Unique; `$b=`$out6 -split '\r?\n' | ForEach-Object { `$_.Trim() } | Where-Object { `$_ -and `$_ -notmatch '^!Time:|^!Last configuration|^Last configuration|^snmp-server user|^username admin password|^crypto pki|^subject-name|^rsakeypair|^quit|^[0-9A-F ]{20,}$' } | Sort-Object -Unique; `$d=Compare-Object `$b `$a; if (`$d) { '===== '+`$dev+' ====='; `$d | Format-Table -AutoSize } } }"
